test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same die are shown below. What is the number on the face opposite to the one having 6?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cfdf5829c3cc37f49ecd9cfa84da9abd499e2198a294dc4d909dd22926ce340.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From, Figure 1 & Figure 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bca08959cec071ee03e51859aab26d6261cf1bed4ce1330fcfc2e3b9ecd63b6e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4de0d6317ee191978a8ce7062e710a764c5e8513dc6729fd51428da7c25596e.png] 

→ Face 5 and 3 are common ⇒ Face 2 and 4 are opposites

From Figure 2 & 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d1e51bec42522bcf25b9cd298e3aa2a74ed8b04c8e8ded2fd39ffcd611966ca.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32efda98b1d62a85d5ff7dbacfc1c5486d4ad9bd08f65f406894803024c5dde2.png] 

→ Face 5 and 4 are common ⇒ **Face 3 and 6 are opposites**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
